name: Mailbox permission observations (selected mailboxes)
description: Explicit FullAccess mailbox-ACL, SendAs and SendOnBehalf source reads. Preserve original principals and rights; no effective-access, AutoMapping or name-resolution claim.

parameters.name: MailboxGuids
parameters.label: Exchange mailbox GUIDs
parameters.help: Choose 1–50 exact Exchange mailbox GUIDs, separated by commas. Names, SMTP addresses and Entra object IDs are not substituted.

parameters.name: FullAccess
parameters.label: Mailbox ACL entries (FullAccess source)
parameters.help: Select this source explicitly; unselected sources are not queried. Unavailable flags remain unknown.

parameters.name: SendAs
parameters.label: SendAs permissions
parameters.help: Select this source explicitly; unselected sources are not queried. Unavailable flags remain unknown.

parameters.name: SendOnBehalf
parameters.label: SendOnBehalf attribute
parameters.help: Select this source explicitly; unselected sources are not queried. Unavailable flags remain unknown.

prerequisites: Approved installed ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later and recipient read access. Role names and module output remain live-unverified; the toolkit installs nothing.
limitations: Experimental read-only Run, off by default; selected mailbox GUIDs and at least one explicit source, current verified context, separate Exchange authentication and exact review remain required.

At most50 targets,5,000 total output rows including target diagnostics,100 source calls,100 values per list,300seconds and32MiB output. Failures, unselected sources and missing counts do not establish zero permissions.
Raw SID/SELF and unresolved labels remain original references, never Entra joins. Returned rights, inheritance and deny values are observations, not effective access or AutoMapping.

SendOnBehalf attribute edges do not expose ACL rights/inheritance/deny; these remain explicitly unsupported/null and make their nonempty source partial. Other source fields missing in a module response remain unknown.
Actual module/RBAC/property shapes and Microsoft behaviour are live-unverified. No permission changes, directory lookup, automatic retry or module installation.
